screen: #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/modules/business-profile to any other module (full, 1440 and 1001 px and wider)
title: Choosing another module in the navigator leaves the page scrolled where it was, drops focus to the body, and announces nothing.
expected: D-38 and D-35: after a control that changes the page is used, focus goes somewhere sensible; CM-028: the navigator moves between modules. A reader who picks a module expects to arrive at its name and bottom line.
actual: ModulePage keys ModuleView by issuer, run and module (Module.tsx:239), so choosing a module link unmounts the navigator that held focus. Focus falls to <body> (pointer and keyboard), the main region keeps its scroll offset (1886 px after Limitations, so Capital structure opens at 'Maturities by year', its name and bottom line scrolled away), document.title stays 'Credit OS' and no live region exists. At 390 px the navigator sits above the content, so the new page opens with its name in view, but focus is still lost. Back and Forward keep the old offset too (1886 px, 'Indicators to watch' first in view).
suggested_change: On a module change scroll #main to the top and move focus to the new module's h2 (give it tabIndex -1), and set document.title to include the module name.

title: The trace control on the Navy bottom-line band takes the Ultramarine focus ring, 2.4:1 against Navy, so keyboard focus is nearly invisible there.
expected: D-34 and D-33: focus indicators 3:1 or better against their surroundings; focus-inverse #4AD4FF on Navy (11.36:1).
actual: The control's onDark variant sets focus-visible:ring-focus (#001AFF) with a Navy offset, and the ring sits on the Navy band (#000533): measured 2.42:1; the screenshot shows a dark blue ring on Navy. The band's own lead heading uses a white ring correctly. The part is TraceControl.tsx (S4's file); the band is BottomLine.tsx (S2's).
suggested_change: In the onDark branch use focus-visible:ring-focus-inverse (the token exists).

screen: every delivered module page with limitations, e.g. #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/modules/business-profile (full, 390 px; also 320 and 480 px)
title: At 480 px and below the Limitations header overflows its card, the page scrolls sideways, and reaching Collapse limitations by keyboard shifts the whole page 104 px left.
expected: D-42: content reflows to one column at 320 px without two-direction scrolling; D-35: focus does not break the layout.
actual: The header row (heading, count, 'See this module's gaps in Evidence' link, collapse button) is one non-wrapping flex row (Limitations.tsx:78-103) whose right edge is at 494 px. At 390 px <main> has scrollWidth 494, the collapse button spans 462-494 px while its card ends at 358 px, and Tab from the gaps link to the collapse button moves scrollLeft from 0 to 104, cutting the left edge of the card and of the page text off. The file is Limitations.tsx (S2); the defect shows on every module page.
suggested_change: Let the header wrap (flex-wrap, min-w-0) or put the link under the heading below 640 px.

title: The six chart kinds are drawn as tables only: no chart, no Chart or Table toggle, and the code comment that justifies it ('the kit has no such chart') is out of date.
expected: D-02, D-28, CM-020, CM-025: each chart is drawn in one frame with its table behind a toggle; ColumnsChart, StackChart, BulletChart, WaterfallChart, ScatterPlot and RangeStripChart match the six `chart` values (columns, stack, bullet, bridge, scatter, range).
actual: Debt stack, Maturities by year, Headroom, Liquidity walk, Leverage and margin against peers and Interest cover against the peer range are table cards. ChartTableBlock.tsx:18-22 and TableCard.tsx:7-13 say the kit has no such chart, but web/src/components/chart/ holds all six and ChartFrame; the connected report draws them. Side effects: a footnote reads 'Not plotted: Peer E' beside a table with nothing plotted, and a reader of the static library sees no chart at all. owner_decision: the mock (docs/design/mocks/library.md departure 10) chose to draw one Table side per page; the owner should say whether that still stands.
suggested_change: Draw each chartTable through ChartFrame with its chart component and keep the existing table as the Table side; none if the owner keeps departure 10.

title: Limitations is drawn last, after every record block, although the matrix and rubric put it straight after the contrary evidence and change-of-view passages.
expected: CM-004 (Modules, after Contrary evidence), CM-005 (order: bottom line, key findings, contrary evidence and what would change the view, limitations, then typed records, figures and tables) and D-11.
actual: Module.tsx:94-103 draws Records and then Limitations. On Capital structure the limitations that qualify the figures start 4,837 px down, after 14 other sections; the 'On this page' list ends with Limitations. A reader of the tables meets the hedge, cost-of-debt and lease qualifications last.
suggested_change: Draw the limitations block before the records and list it before Records in the navigator.

title: The module navigator has no search at the top and no labelled picker on narrow screens: at 390 px a flat list of every module pushes the module's name 1,012 px down.
expected: CM-028, CT-044 and decision 5 of the reader ruling: 'Search sits at the top'; narrow screens use a labelled picker and section menu (react-module-coverage.md).
actual: ModuleNav draws two always-open lists. There is no search field or picker control at any width. Below 1001 px the grid becomes one column (Module.tsx:175) so the navigator comes first: with 13 modules the module heading starts 1,012 px from the top of a 844 px-high window and the bottom line is a second screen away.
suggested_change: Add the search input above the lists and, below 1001 px, collapse the lists into a labelled picker and section menu.

title: Ten of the thirteen fixture modules draw their bottom line, key finding and limitation with no trace control, and Capital structure's statement table and four tests have none: a null trace silently draws nothing.
expected: CM-008 and CM-009, D-06: exactly one trace control per paragraph, row or figure; AGENTS.md: missing handoff content stays an explicit gap, not an absence.
actual: TraceControl returns null when trace is null (TraceControl.tsx:28), the reader accepts null for every passage (slice.ts:135,151,175), and the fixture holds null on the bottom line, finding 01 and the limitation of ten modules, on four 'Documentation tests' items and on the 'Debt and leverage by year' table (25 cells). Those items show no control and no sign that no source was recorded; the reader has no way to ask where they come from.
suggested_change: Refuse a null trace on a delivered module's passages in the reader, or draw an explicit 'No source recorded' marker; fix the fixture.

title: On the shipped build every module route shows one bare sentence in builder wording ('This data file holds no library pages') with no designed empty state and no next step.
expected: D-31: empty is the empty state with featured icon, title, one sentence and the next action; D-01 and D-16: reader wording, not 'data file'.
actual: With web/dist as built (issuers: []) the page is an h1 'Modules' and a paragraph; no icon, link or button on the page (the shell rail is the only way out). The UUI EmptyState used by Absent (NotHeld.tsx:9-26) is not used. The notice is drawn by LibraryPage.tsx (S2).
suggested_change: Draw the notice through Absent with a plain sentence and a Back to the library link.

title: One malformed record makes every library page unreadable and prints the reader's internal data path in the page body.
expected: D-31 and D-05: no raw error string, no machinery on a findings page; the error is an alert with an action.
actual: Changing one record kind in one module makes Library home, Overview and every module page show 'This part of the library could not be read' followed by 'issuers[0].runs[0].modules[0].body.records[0].kind: expected one of matrix, watch, …' as plain text, with no alert, icon or action. The renderer is App.tsx:76-83 (S1). Unusual input, registered and parked under R3.
suggested_change: Show the alert form with a plain sentence and an action, and keep the data path out of the page body (for example behind a details control).

title: The static module vocabulary has eleven record kinds, so the matrix's dated lanes, case cards, for-and-against board, trend and path charts, comparisons, ranked bars, dumbbells, limits and rating pairs have no form on the static module page.
expected: content-matrix rows with section S3 whose component is R4, R9, P6, C2, C3, C5, C8, C11, C13, C15, F6, an EdgeMap or an EventLane (79 rows); H-25 says stage 2 should check what the fixture holds, not require every row.
actual: slice.ts:404-415 and read.ts:1215-1250 accept matrix, watch, questions, edges, metrics, measures, facts, status, statement, chartTable and gap. Nothing in the static app can draw an event lane, a case card, a for-and-against board, a trend or path chart, a comparison, ranked bars, a dumbbell, a limits chart, a rating pair or a confidence score (CM-080). The 85 content rows that need those forms are marked missing in harmony.csv. owner_decision: whether the static app is meant to carry them or only the connected report.
suggested_change: none

title: The reason the Forecast tab is unavailable ('No forecast for this run') is 12 px grey at 2.19:1, helper text in the disabled colour.
expected: D-33: text 4.5:1; text-disabled is for inactive controls only and grey disabled helper text is the rubric's own fail example; D-30: nothing under 13 px.
actual: RunTabLink draws the hint inside the disabled tab, so it takes text-disabled (#A4A9B1) on the canvas (#F6F5FF) at text-xs (12 px): 2.19:1. The tab label may stay disabled; the sentence that explains why carries information. The file is RunFrame.tsx (S2) and the tab strip appears on every run page.
suggested_change: Draw the hint in text-tertiary at 13 px or more outside the disabled span.

title: A module that could not be assessed or did not run shows its reason without a Bottom line.
expected: CM-007, CT-040 and D-11: a blocked module's page shows a Bottom line saying it is not assessable and why.
actual: BlockedModule (Module.tsx:109-140) draws a Not assessable badge (or Not run), the reason, a note and a gap link; there is no Bottom line label or band, no h3, and the 'On this page' group is empty.
suggested_change: Draw the reason as the Bottom line band (the slice already holds the reason text).

title: Modules that did not run (Not run, a capped run) are listed in the navigator and open pages, although CT-044 says only modules that ran are listed.
expected: CT-044: 'Only modules that ran in the selected run are listed'; decision 5: a module that ran but was blocked is listed and marked Not assessable.
actual: The capped run lists Financial performance, Cash flow and liquidity, Recovery and Forecast as Not run, each with a page. Module state 'Not run' is a designed state (sets.ts), so this may be intended; owner_decision.
suggested_change: none

title: The fixture's only data module (Source readiness) shows a bottom line and nothing after it.
expected: CM-006, CM-094: a data module owes the bottom line and then its tables as the main content.
actual: records is empty, so the page is the bottom line band over an empty canvas; the readiness groups, coverage and supersession of CM-094, CM-119, CM-120 and CM-121 cannot be seen. The reader allows an empty data module.
suggested_change: Give the fixture's data module a status block and facts, or have the reader require one record.

title: Text under 13 px on the module page: the navigator's group headings, the change line of every measure, group names in the terms list, the test counts and notes.
expected: D-30: nothing written here is set below 13 px (caption 13/18).
actual: text-xs (12 px) at ModuleNav.tsx:72, Measure.tsx:21 (the delivered change, 'Lower by 0.3x on 2025', and the 'Earlier period n.a.' line), FactsBlock.tsx:16, StatusBlock.tsx:30 and :54. UUI badge text (the Modules tab count) keeps its source size.
suggested_change: Use text-caption (13 px) for these lines.

title: A long unbroken word overflows its row: an indicator threshold runs under the neighbouring column, a fact value and a key-finding lead run past the card.
expected: D-32: long text wraps in full and is never cut; WatchBlock's own detail list already uses wrap-anywhere.
actual: In WatchBlock the threshold span (WatchBlock.tsx:44) and in FactsBlock the value cell (FactsBlock.tsx:27-28) have no overflow-wrap rule; Findings' lead (Findings.tsx:23, S2) likewise. A 136-character token drew 340 px beyond its column. Sentences with spaces wrap correctly everywhere tested.
suggested_change: Add wrap-anywhere and min-w-0 to those spans.

title: Each limitation is clamped to three lines with an ellipsis behind a Show all control, although only the card is meant to collapse and nothing is to be cut.
expected: D-32: passages and long cells wrap in full; only the limitations card collapses; a limitation cut with an ellipsis is the rubric's fail example.
actual: Limitation (Limitations.tsx:15-48) uses line-clamp-3 and shows Show all only when it measures overflow; at 1440 px the second limitation is cut at '… on inpu…'. The text is complete after the click and in print, so the qualification is reachable. owner_decision: the clamp is a deliberate design.
suggested_change: none

title: The Show all and Show less controls are 57 by 20 px, under the 24 px minimum target.
expected: D-41 (WCAG 2.5.8): pointer targets at least 24 by 24 CSS px unless spaced.
actual: The small link-gray button measures 57x20 px with the trace control 28 px above-right of it.
suggested_change: Give the button min-h-6 or padding.

title: A loading run shows the Overview-shaped skeleton on the Modules routes, with no name or status for a screen reader, and the Modules tab turns disabled while the reader is on it.
expected: D-31: the skeleton has the shape of what will arrive; D-43: status is announced.
actual: RunSkeleton (RunFrame.tsx:209-241) is one banner, three tiles and two rows for every tab; the Modules page has a navigator and a heading. aria-busy is set but no label, role=status or live region; head.firstModule is null while loading so the Modules tab is plain text and nothing is marked current.
suggested_change: Label the skeleton ('Loading this run') and keep the current tab marked.

title: The statement table has no card and mixes surfaces: white header and label column, canvas-coloured figure cells.
expected: D-21 and D-26: sibling tables sit in the same card; D-33 surfaces agree.
actual: StatementBlock draws the table straight on the canvas, but its header cells and sticky label cells take bg-surface-card (StatementBlock.tsx:9-10, :41, :59) so the white shows as an L-shape around transparent figure cells; every chart table beside it is a white card.
suggested_change: Draw the statement in a TableCard-style card or drop the white fills.

title: At 390 px wide tables are clipped at the card edge with no scroll cue: the risk matrix shows 'Imp' and 'Hi' and its per-risk trace controls are out of sight.
expected: D-42: data tables may scroll but the reader must be able to tell; D-32: nothing cut.
actual: ChartTable's wrapper is overflow-x-auto (ChartTable.tsx:70) with no shadow or edge cue. In the matrix the Impact column header ends at 368 px while the scroll area ends at 337 px, so 'Impact' and each grade show as 'Imp', 'Hi', 'Medi'; the trace controls are off-screen.
suggested_change: Add an edge fade or reduce column padding at 390 px.

title: Every scrollable table wrapper is an unnamed generic element that becomes a tab stop with the browser's default focus ring.
expected: D-35 and D-37: operable with a name; D-34: the design focus ring.
actual: Six wrappers (ChartTable.tsx:70, StatementBlock.tsx:36) scroll at 390 px; Chromium makes each focusable (a Tab stop between the table card's controls) with no role or accessible name and the UA outline, not the 2 px Ultramarine ring. Behaviour depends on the browser version.
suggested_change: Give the wrapper role=region, an aria-label from the caption and tabIndex 0 with the design ring.

title: Trace controls repeat one generic name: four 'Show sources for this finding', five 'for this risk', four 'for this indicator', seven 'for this fact'.
expected: D-37: no two different actions share the same generic name on one page; a specific name is better.
actual: Findings.tsx:26, MatrixBlock.tsx:22, WatchBlock.tsx:47-51 and FactsBlock.tsx:30 use one string per kind. The drawer's own name is specific ('Sources for tariff exposure'), so the data exists; WatchBlock and StatusBlock already build specific names for the connected variants.
suggested_change: Append the item's own label to the name (for example 'Show sources for Tariff exposure').

title: The navigator sits before the content in tab order, so the first content control is about 20 Tab presses from the Evidence tab (6 section buttons and 13 module links).
expected: D-35: a skip link or landmark to reach content.
actual: Module.tsx:175-185 puts the navigator first in the DOM. The shell's Skip to content lands before it. The nav is a landmark so a screen reader can jump past it, a keyboard user cannot.
suggested_change: Add a 'Skip to the module' link after the tabs or make the navigator one tab stop group.

title: The 'On this page' marker only changes when a section is chosen: after reading on or scrolling back it still names the old section.
expected: CM-028: the outline shows where the reader is; aria-current=location must be true.
actual: ModuleView sets active on click only (Module.tsx:162-172); with Limitations chosen and the page scrolled back to the top aria-current is still Limitations.
suggested_change: Update active from an IntersectionObserver, or drop aria-current.

title: The navigator entry for the typed record blocks is called 'Records', which tells a reader nothing.
expected: D-16: headings carry information; D-04: nothing reads as stored data.
actual: recordSections falls back to the label 'Records' for blocks with no nav label (recordNav.ts:24-27); on Business profile it stands for a risk matrix, indicators, questions and a pathway.
suggested_change: Have delivery send a nav label for these blocks (the data modules already carry one).

screen: #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/modules/capital-structure (full) Debt stack, Leverage and margin against peers
title: A footnote prints the label 'Basis:' and another says 'Not plotted' beside a table that plots nothing.
expected: D-04 and D-12: no 'Basis:' line on a findings page; the Basis is behind the trace control.
actual: The fixture footnote reads 'Basis: drawn amounts at face value; leases as reported.' and TableCard draws footnotes verbatim (TableCard.tsx:71-75); 'Not plotted: Peer E (margin n.a.)' follows from S3-004. Whether the label comes from delivery or the fixture was not established.
suggested_change: Strip the label in delivery (the sentence is a qualification, not a source line).

title: The sticky navigator scrolls inside itself and does not bring the current module into view: at 1366x768 and 1280x720 the current entry can sit below the navigator's edge, and with 53 modules it is about 2,260 px down the list.
expected: CM-028: the navigator stays in view and shows the open entry.
actual: ModuleNav caps its height at 100vh - 3rem with overflow-y-auto (ModuleNav.tsx:76-78) and never scrolls the aria-current entry into view; Capital structure at 1366x768: entry at 720-758 against a navigator ending at 744; Credit snapshot at 1280x720: below the edge.
suggested_change: On mount call scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) on the current entry inside the navigator.

title: At 320 px the New run button runs 47 px past the window edge.
expected: D-42: reflow at 320 px.
actual: The header's action row (Show sources, Report history, New run) ends at 367 px in a 320 px window (RunFrame.tsx:193-200, S2).
suggested_change: Let the action row wrap.

title: The Modules navigator has no Model entry although decision 3 says the delivered Model appears as an entry in Modules.
expected: CM-030, decision 3 and H-05: the Model is an entry in Modules (and the grid on Forecast).
actual: The static app keeps the Model in its own section (#/model/*, S5); ModuleNav lists only the run's modules. H-05 records the conflict; owner_decision.
suggested_change: none

title: Props and branches in the S3 files are reachable only from the connected report; the static reader drops WatchRecord.detail.
expected: AGENTS.md: record what no input reaches (stage 6 input, not a defect).
actual: WatchBlock detail (WatchBlock.tsx:29,48,53-55), StatementBlock traceForRow (:23-24, :72-80), StatusBlock hideEmptyValue (:15,38,43,47) and ModuleNav hrefFor are set only by pages/connected; readWatch (read.ts:821) never reads detail, so a detail field in library.json is silently dropped. Not dead code: the connected report uses them.
suggested_change: none

title: StatementBlock shadows its row index with the cell index inside the row's map.
expected: no-shadow style; the outer index feeds traceForRow.
actual: rows.map((row, index) …) at :52 and row.cells.map((cell, index) …) at :62: the outer value is read only after the inner map, so behaviour is right, but a later edit that moves traceForRow inside the cells map would pass the wrong index.
suggested_change: Rename the inner index.

title: The static fixture holds none of the CP modules, so most per-module matrix rows cannot be marked from a screen.
expected: H-25: stage 2 should check what the fixture holds, not require every row.
actual: The fixture's 13 synthetic modules (business profile, capital structure, …) and the Brevane pair map to no CP module; 69 content rows whose component exists in the static vocabulary but whose module is absent are marked missing in harmony.csv with this id. They are not renderer defects.
suggested_change: none

title: The 'No modules in this run' state is reachable only by a slice whose Overview names no module through an item with module null.
expected: Module.tsx:226-230 is a designed state.
actual: firstHeld lets firstModule be null (read.ts:1432) but readModules requires at least one Overview item (read.ts:613-625) whose module must be held, unless it is an item with module null; building such a slice needs a long list of matching Evidence edits, so the state was not rendered (listed under Not verified).
suggested_change: none

title: Ten items on the module screens are named by no content-matrix row: the Show sources switch, the run-header actions, the module state badge, the gaps link, the limitations collapse and clamp controls, the Not run page text, the no-such-module state, the loading skeleton and the Forecast hint.
expected: stage 2 brief check 4: list anything the screens show that no matrix row accounts for.
actual: Listed as unaccounted rows in harmony.csv. Most are run-frame or state screens (RunFrame.tsx, NotHeld.tsx, Limitations.tsx) shared with S2; none looks wrong in itself, and findings S3-003, S3-011, S3-013, S3-017 and S3-019 cover the ones with defects.
suggested_change: Add rows for the run frame, the module state badge and the states to the matrix.

title: The three facts of a facility share one trace, so the drawer for Margin, Maturity, Drawn or Commitment fee is headed and totalled with the facility's size.
expected: D-06 and D-15: the control on a figure opens that figure's own source; CM-009: one control per row.
actual: Amount, Margin and Maturity of Term loan B all carry trace cs-term-loan and open 'Term loan B USD 1,150m' with Result 'Term loan B USD 1,150m'; Size, Drawn (USD 0m) and Commitment fee (n.a.) all open 'Revolving facility USD 250m'. The statement text in each drawer covers the whole facility, so nothing is false, but the heading and Result do not match the row that was opened. The drawer content is S4's; the sharing is in the fixture and allowed by the reader.
suggested_change: Give each fact its own trace (or name the row in the drawer heading) in delivery and the fixture.

title: Navigator entries show a module's state only as a small shape; the word (Delivered with gaps, Not assessable, Not run) is in the accessible name but not drawn.
expected: D-29 and D-39: each state has a shape and a word; ModuleNav.tsx:44-48 says each entry shows 'its state shape and word'; CM-028 and CM-007: the blocked module is marked Not assessable.
actual: Each entry draws a 10 px shape and the module name. A sighted reader sees a dashed ring, a slashed circle or a ring with no legend; the state word appears only on the page heading row once the module is open. Not colour alone, so not a D-39 failure, but the 'word' of D-29 is missing.
suggested_change: Draw the state word on entries whose state is not Delivered, or add a legend.

title: The stage 0 inventory was taken at 1440 px only, so controls that exist only at narrow widths are not in it: the keyboard-focusable table scrollers at 390 px.
expected: stage 2 brief check 1: a control missing from the inventory is a finding against stage 0.
actual: clickables.jsonl has no width field and crawl.mjs enumerates controls at 1440x900; the six wrappers of S3-022 are implicit tab stops with no tabindex attribute, which its selector (`[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])`) also cannot see. No other missing control was found on S3 screens; the run-frame controls (Library, Overview, Changes, Modules, Evidence, Report history, New run, Show sources) are tagged S3 on module addresses although RunFrame.tsx belongs to S2 (382 of the 1,616 lines).
suggested_change: none
